description.value: Browns Socialhouse is a proudly Canadian franchise chain with over 80 locations, describing itself as the balance between a neighbourhood pub and upscale casual dining. The Cambie Street location sits in downtown Vancouver near the Queen Elizabeth Theatre precinct and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. Touring cyclists would find a full-service sit-down meal with a broad menu in a central urban location.
